source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Chapter 7 summary (PDF 191).

blocks.text: Terms of use service ke istemal ke qanooni muahide hain; inhein todna jurmana, muqadma ya pabandi la sakta; yeh munsifana aur shaffaf hone chahiyein; aur users privacy, maloomat aur raza wapas lene ke huqooq rakhte hain. Spam, spyware, cookies, phishing aur pharming privacy aur hifazat ko khatra hain, aur filters, antivirus, cookie management aur hoshiyari in se bachati hai. Digital divide na-barabar mauqe paida karta aur technology tak barabar rasai se kam hota hai. Zimmedar users maakhaz parkhte, tanqeedi sochte, achhe digital shehri bante aur mawad accessible banate hain.

items: Apni shiqein aur huqooq jaanein, khatron se bachein, faasla kam karein, maloomat parkhein, achhe digital shehri banein.
